name: Two-Renderer Reconstruction Pipeline
definition: A rendering pipeline that separates surface reflectance and subsurface scattering (SSS) into two stages to enable differentiable inverse rendering of translucent objects, avoiding the high memory/compute cost of full path tracing and the inability of direct-only renderers to model SSS.
summary: The Two-Renderer Reconstruction Pipeline decouples surface reflectance and subsurface scattering into a non-differentiable physical step and a differentiable neural step, avoiding full path tracing costs.
